title: Subscription Tier List: How Much API Usage $1 Buys
brief: Adam Holter's tier list ranks twelve model-and-plan combinations by how much API usage $1 of subscription buys, from Grok 4.7 on X Premium+ ($80) and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 on Claude Max 20x ($66) in S tier down to Gemini 4 Argon on Google AI Pro ($2.8) in F tier, with Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-5 Astra, Gemini 3.0 Flash and GLM 5.3 in between. It is a quick way to compare which subscription gives the most model usage per dollar across ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Google AI Pro, X Premium+ and GLM Coding Pro — presented as a 10-second video, not a page. - Warning: the dollar figures are the author's own and unverified — the video's methodology footnote was not legible, and Yash himself asked for the workings in the thread; some listed model names are unverified. Treat the ranking as one person's comparison, not measured pricing.

details: Adam Holter's tier list is a 10-second video ranking twelve model-and-plan combinations by API usage per $1 of subscription, from S tier (Grok 4.7 on X Premium+ at $80, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 on Claude Max 20x at $66) through A tier (Claude Haiku 5.5 at $47, GPT-5 Astra on ChatGPT Plus at $32), B tier (Gemini 3.0 Flash $25, GPT-5.1 Sol $24, GPT-5 Luna $19, GPT-5.1 Terra $18), C tier (GLM 5.3 $9.6, Claude Fable 5.1 $6.4) to F tier (Gemini 4 Argon $2.8). It answers a practical question — which subscription buys the most model usage per dollar — across ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max 20x, Google AI Pro, X Premium+ and GLM Coding Pro. The figures are the author's own and unverified: the video's methodology footnote was not legible at the available resolution, and Yash asked for the workings in the thread. The post was shared by 0xSaiya as useful and by thelaggingway, and the video is the whole resource — there is no linked page or data table behind it.
